permissions.description: Mouthy needs one permission to read your selected text.

accessibility.title: Přístup k usnadnění
accessibility.description: Required to copy the text you select so Mouthy can read it aloud.

errors.checkFailed: Nepodařilo se zkontrolovat oprávnění. Zkuste to prosím znovu.
errors.requestFailed: Nepodařilo se požádat o oprávnění. Zkuste to prosím znovu.

shortcut.title: Zkratky Mouthy
shortcut.description: Configure the keyboard shortcuts that read your selection or clipboard aloud

speak.name: Speak Selection
speak.description: Reads the selected text aloud. Press again to stop.

speak_clipboard.name: Speak Clipboard
speak_clipboard.description: Reads the text you copied aloud. Press again to stop.

errors.reset: Nepodařilo se vrátit zkratku na původní hodnotu

desktop.title: Desktop shortcuts
desktop.description: On Wayland, Mouthy's shortcuts are set in your desktop's settings. Bind each command below to a key: in KDE Plasma, System Settings → Keyboard → Shortcuts → Add New → Command or Script. Other desktops are untested.
desktop.notRunning: A shortcut pressed while Mouthy is not running only starts it; press it again to speak.
desktop.noArguments: If a shortcut does nothing, the desktop may be dropping the command's arguments: bind a two-line script that runs the command instead.
desktop.eventTap: To set shortcuts here instead, turn on Experimental Features under Advanced and choose Event Tap. It needs your user in the input group, which lets any program you run read every key you type.
desktop.password: Password managers seldom mark a copied password on Linux, so Speak Clipboard may read one aloud.
desktop.wlPasteNotFound: wl-clipboard is not installed, so nothing can be read. Install it with your distribution's package manager, or on an immutable one such as Bazzite with: brew install wl-clipboard

backend.title: Speech Engine
backend.description: Local (offline) runs the Kokoro voice on this Mac, from files you download on the Models page. HTTP server sends the selected text to the server URL below.

backendUrl.title: Server URL
backendUrl.description: Address of the OpenAI-compatible speech server, such as Kokoro-FastAPI. Selected text is sent to it; plain http is unencrypted. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8880

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Pick a voice, preview it, or blend it with a second one. Offline voices download from the list or the Models page; with the HTTP server, the list is the server's.
voice.serverSlow: The server has not answered in 10 seconds.
voice.serverUnreachable: Could not get the server's voices: {{error}}
voice.serverEmpty: The server lists no voices. Type one under Other.
voice.noneInstalled: No voice is downloaded yet. Download one below, or manage files on the Models page.
voice.modelMissing: The offline model is not downloaded yet, so voices cannot speak or preview.

showUninstalled.title: Show uninstalled voices
showUninstalled.description: List voices you have not downloaded yet, with a Download button for each.

other.title: Other voice or blend
other.description: Any voice id the list lacks, or a blend such as bm_lewis(70)+bm_george(30).

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: Mix the voice in use with a second voice; the slider sets each one's share.
blend.none: No other voice to blend with
blend.language: A blend reads in its first voice's language and accent.

espeak.title: Pronounce unknown words with espeak-ng
espeak.description: Names and other English words the built-in dictionary lacks are read by espeak-ng instead of spelled out letter by letter. Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese and Hindi voices need espeak-ng to read at all, whether this is on or off. espeak-ng is GPL-3 software you install yourself (brew install espeak-ng); Mouthy runs it as a separate program and does not bundle it. Each new unknown word can delay speech by up to half a second.
espeak.notFound: espeak-ng is not installed. Install it with: brew install espeak-ng
espeak.notFoundLinux: espeak-ng is not installed. Install it with your distribution's package manager, or on an immutable one such as Bazzite with: brew install espeak-ng

language.title: Reading Language
language.description: Which language the offline voice reads text in. Choose English to have a voice of another language, such as Spanish or Japanese, read English text, with its own accent.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast the voice speaks, from 0.5× to 2×.

outputDevice.title: Výstupní zařízení
outputDevice.description: Select the audio device that plays speech

status.title: Status
status.server: Mouthy is using the HTTP server. These files are used when Speech Engine is Local (offline).
status.unlistedVoice: Voice {{voice}} has no file here: pick one below, or type a listed voice in General.
status.failed: The offline voice did not load: {{error}}
status.ready: Ready to speak offline with the {{model}} model and the {{voice}} voice.

model.title: Model
model.description: Mouthy uses one model at a time. int8 is the smallest and fastest; fp32 is the original, full-precision model.
model.fp32: Full precision: about twice as slow as int8, uses the most memory

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: English voices read English (British voices with British pronunciation, the rest American); Spanish, French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Hindi voices read their own language and need espeak-ng; Japanese voices read Japanese, and kanji once the Japanese dictionary below is downloaded; Chinese voices read Mandarin.

dictionary.title: Japanese Dictionary
dictionary.description: Lets Japanese voices read kanji: without it they read kana only, and text that is mostly kanji is not read. It takes 80 MB once unpacked.
dictionary.name: NAIST Japanese Dictionary
dictionary.source: From jpreprocess on GitHub, BSD licence
dictionary.mismatch: The dictionary download does not match what Mouthy expects; a newer Mouthy may be needed.

folder.title: Models Folder
folder.description: Where the downloaded files are kept.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: Kokoro-82M by hexgrad, converted to ONNX by onnx-community and downloaded from Hugging Face, is released under the Apache License 2.0.

experimentalToggle.label: Experimentální funkce
experimentalToggle.description: Povolit experimentální funkce, které jsou stále ve vývoji.

startHidden.label: Spouštět skrytě
startHidden.description: Spustit do systémové lišty bez otevření okna.

autostart.label: Spouštět při startu
autostart.description: Automaticky spustit Mouthy po přihlášení do počítače.

showTrayIcon.label: Zobrazit ikonu v systémové liště
showTrayIcon.description: Zobrazit ikonu Mouthy v systémové liště.

style.title: Překryv
style.description: Choose the overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill.

position.title: Pozice překryvu
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen while Mouthy is speaking.

logDirectory.title: Složka protokolů
logDirectory.description: Umístění, kde jsou uloženy soubory protokolu

liveLogs.title: Živé logy
liveLogs.description: Sledujte logy aplikace v reálném čase a diagnostikujte problémy bez otevírání souboru logu. Zobrazují se pouze logy vytvořené, když je tento panel otevřený; respektuje nastavení Úroveň logování výše.
liveLogs.empty: Čekání na logy… Záznamy se zde zobrazí, jakmile je aplikace vygeneruje.

keyboardImplementation.title: Implementace klávesnice
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Klávesové zkratky byly nekompatibilní a byly obnoveny na výchozí hodnoty
keyboardImplementation.bindingsUnbound: Some keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and are now unset, because another shortcut uses their default keys

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Diagnostika klávesnice
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Ověří, zda události klávesnice dorazí do Mouthy. Zaznamenává se pouze počet událostí — nikdy to, které klávesy stisknete.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Naslouchání… několikrát stiskněte svou zkratku (např. Option+Escape)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input blokuje události kláves — zkratky obsahující běžnou klávesu nemohou fungovat, dokud se to nevyřeší.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Dorazily události modifikátorů, ale žádné události kláves — něco klávesy potlačuje, přestože Secure Input hlásí, že je vypnutý. Nahlaste to prosím na GitHubu.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Události kláves dorazí do Mouthy normálně.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: Nebyly zachyceny žádné události — stiskli jste během testu nějaké klávesy?

onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions or completion state
